    Simultaneous socle rejection for a basic projective-injective family #

    This file packages the sum of the embedded socle ideals belonging to a finite basic family of indecomposable projective-injective right modules. Its first layer identifies the modules surviving the simultaneous quotient.

    TwoSidedIdeal A

    The two-sided annihilator in A of a right A-module represented as a left Aᵐᵒᵖ-module.
